title: Opportunity Brief
description: A decision-ready brief that separates verified facts from interpretation. Stage 05 output. Review Gate 2.

supportingEvidenceIds.description: evidenceIds from the validated list in 03-validation.json.

verifiedFacts.description: Each must be backed by a validated evidence item.

recommendedNextAction.description: A research or marketing action only. Never outreach/contact.

contacts.description: People found at this organisation matching a target role. Optional — an empty or absent list is an honest result, not a failure. Never used to trigger outreach; a human decides what to do with this information.

role.description: The job title as found, verbatim.

sourceUrl.description: The exact URL this contact was found at. Never invent.

uncertainty.description: What is unconfirmed about this contact, e.g. role may be outdated.

humanVerificationRequired.description: There is always at least one thing a human must confirm.
